item.title: Filmhouse opens at Golden Mile Tower, bringing arthouse cinema back to Singapore
item.description: Independent cinema has a new home. Filmhouse officially opens on 3 February at Golden Mile Tower, taking over the former site of The Projector, and marking a fresh chapter for Singapore’s cinephile community.
